_meta.eta_definition: dirty-image rms at the operating point divided by the natural-untapered dirty rms, at the 30 GHz reference. Convention warning: theta here is geometric-mean FWHM in mas; mstroh/subarray_data.json thetas are quadrature-sum values, about sqrt(2) larger for near-circular beams (see mstroh_comparison.md finding 1). Convention warning: b_min/b_max here are physical 3-D baseline lengths from the Rev F .cfg files; Stroh's are projected-uv baselines at mid-track.
_meta.spline_convention: x = log10(theta_mas), y = eta, scipy PPoly [c, x]
_meta.curve_selection_policy: point_source is the engine min-eta curve. imaging_s0_0.10 is strict skirt <= 0.10 where a strict capped-domain run exists; otherwise it is the engine relaxed best-achievable-skirt curve, marked selection_policy='relaxed_best_achievable_no_strict_domain'.
_meta.knot_policy: seed knots are every 5th kept point plus endpoints; additional knots are inserted adaptively until dense-grid relative error is below 0.009
